For InstantSearch v2 you can group refinements based on the attribute then, since the connector does not expose any way to clear multiple refinements at one, you''l need to reproduce part of [`connectCurrentRefinedValues` internals](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/12f473283c555c2c9ef5f3e3883486eddfb37448/src/connectors/current-refined-values/connectCurrentRefinedValues.js#L356-L394).

Based on the example from [connectCurrentRefinedValues](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectCurrentRefinedValues.html#example) here's a possible implementation of this: https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-app-i15st
